<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 Disponibles

Los umbrales se basan en observaciones comunitarias. Las contribuciones privadas pueden contar si la opción está activada.

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

Crear un repositorio que alcance **16 estrellas**; los niveles superiores dependen de sus estrellas.

**Niveles:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (estrellas del repositorio).

[Ejemplo real](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

Ser autor de **2 pull requests fusionadas**.

**Niveles:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (PR fusionadas del autor).

[Ejemplo real](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

Ser coautor de commits en **1 PR fusionada**, con una atribución `Co-authored-by` correcta.

**Niveles:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (PR fusionadas con coautoría).

[Ejemplo real](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

Obtener **2 respuestas aceptadas** en Discussions. En `github.com/orgs/community` desactivado desde 2024-02-06.

**Niveles:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (respuestas aceptadas).

[Ejemplo real](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="quickdraw"></a>
### Quickdraw

<img src="../assets/badges/quickdraw-default.png" width="96" alt="Quickdraw">

Cerrar una issue o PR **en los 5 minutos** siguientes a su apertura.

[Ejemplo real](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S25](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="yolo"></a>
### YOLO

<img src="../assets/badges/yolo-default.png" width="96" alt="YOLO">

Fusionar una PR propia **sin revisión de código**; las reglas oficiales detalladas no están publicadas.

[Ejemplo real](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S26](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="retired"></a>
## 🕰️ Históricos

Estos eventos han terminado. Las insignias existentes pueden permanecer; las contribuciones nuevas no las desbloquean.

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

Contribuir a un repositorio elegible de la **instantánea Arctic Code Vault del 2020-02-02**. Evento cerrado.

[Ejemplo real](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<a id="mars-2020-contributor"></a>
### Mars 2020 Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

Escribir un commit en una versión concreta usada por **NASA/JPL Ingenuity**. El evento terminó.

[Ejemplo real](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=mars-2020-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ Distintivos de perfil

Los Highlights son distintivos separados de programas y cuentas; su disponibilidad depende del programa.

| Nombre | Estado | Condición | Fuentes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | Disponibles | Usar GitHub Pro. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | Disponibles | Participar en Developer Program y crear una aplicación con la API de GitHub. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | Disponibles | Informar de una vulnerabilidad elegible de GitHub mediante Bug Bounty. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | Disponibles | Participar en GitHub Campus Experts; consultar las reglas actuales de solicitud. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | Disponibles | Recibir crédito en un aviso de seguridad aceptado en GitHub Advisory Database. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | Disponibles | Ser seleccionado para GitHub Stars; las estrellas de un repositorio no bastan. | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | Históricos | Distintivo histórico de respuestas aceptadas; su sustitución por Galaxy Brain se informó en 2022. | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |

### El caso Proxima

Capturas y tarjetas coinciden: Pioneer — prototipo M0; Staffshipper — instancia M8; Staffuser — incorporación del equipo.

| Logro | Cuenta | UTC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Proxima Pioneer](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-pioneer&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2023-06-01T17:34:35Z |
| [Proxima Staffshipper](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-staffshipper&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2024-08-21T22:28:27Z |
| [Proxima Staffuser](https://github.com/timrogers?achievement=proxima-staffuser&tab=achievements) | @timrogers | 2023-08-16T18:28:07Z |

«inaccessible» indica falta de acceso al evento. Staffshipper: 2024-08-22 en la captura, 2024-08-21 en UTC.

[Investigación detallada (EN / RU)](../docs/research.en.md)
